sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: This Suit was a part of the archaeological team sent to [[Valley of the Kings, Egypt]] under [[Klaus]] to uncover the [[Tomb of Nefertiti]]. He met [[Dante Vale]]'s team, stating to be a part of a government did, and then brought them to speak with Klaus. As Klaus recognized Dante's team and initiated an attack, this Suit invoked his [[Ammit Heart-Eater]] and then caught Dante by the throat. Dante, however, was freed when this Suit was blasted by [[Touchram]]. The team of Suits nearly overpowered Dante's team, but they managed to escape. {{source|All Work and No Pay}} He and [[unnamed Suit 026|unnamed Suits 026]], [[unnamed Suit 028|028]], and [[unnamed Suit 033|033]] responded to an explosion set off by Dante and went to investigate the explosives shed. Following the investigation, he and a team of Suits caught up to Dante's team in the Tomb of Nefertiti, and he invoked Ammit Heart-Eater. Dante's team, however, escaped further into the tomb. When the Organization caught up to Dante's team at a pool, he was attacked by [[Gareon]]. {{source|The Sceptre Deception}}

full_text:
Unnamed Suit 030 is a Suit working with Klaus within in the Organization at the site of the Tomb of Nefertiti in Egypt.

== History ==
This Suit was a part of the archaeological team sent to Valley of the Kings, Egypt under Klaus to uncover the Tomb of Nefertiti. He met Dante Vale's team, stating to be a part of a government did, and then brought them to speak with Klaus. As Klaus recognized Dante's team and initiated an attack, this Suit invoked his Ammit Heart-Eater and then caught Dante by the throat. Dante, however, was freed when this Suit was blasted by Touchram. The team of Suits nearly overpowered Dante's team, but they managed to escape. [All Work and No Pay] He and unnamed Suits 026, 028, and 033 responded to an explosion set off by Dante and went to investigate the explosives shed. Following the investigation, he and a team of Suits caught up to Dante's team in the Tomb of Nefertiti, and he invoked Ammit Heart-Eater. Dante's team, however, escaped further into the tomb. When the Organization caught up to Dante's team at a pool, he was attacked by Gareon. [The Sceptre Deception]

== Abilities ==
This Suit is capable of the basic powers of an Organization Seeker. He also likes to use a cutlass in battle. 

===Bonded Titans===
* Ammit Heart-Eater
